summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 11.3% YoY to INR165.6 crore with gross margin up 210 bps to 48.3%; management guides 10-15% revenue growth for FY27.
summary.overview: Bajaj Healthcare reported Q1 FY27 revenue of INR165.6 crore, up 11.3% YoY and 8.2% QoQ, with EBITDA of about INR29.6 crore (17.8% margin) and PAT from continuing operations of INR13.9 crore (8.4% margin). Domestic API was the main growth driver at INR92.3 crore (up 27% YoY), while exports (INR50.1 crore) and formulations (INR23.3 crore) contributed the rest. Management guided FY27 revenue growth of 10-15% and EBITDA margins of 18-20% for FY27 and FY28, and reiterated pipeline timelines for peptide, oncology API, and CDMO/novel-drug launches. Receivable days fell to 131 from 145 at FY26 end, and the call was the company's first earnings call.

segments.name: Domestic API
segments.commentary: Revenue INR92.3 crore, up 27% YoY; management said API prices were broadly stable QoQ and the growth was not price-led. Ascorbic acid and salts contribute about 8-10% of revenue.

segments.name: Export
segments.commentary: Revenue INR50.1 crore in Q1. Magnesium L-Threonate (nutraceutical ingredient supplied to a US innovator) is the largest export product at about 10% of FY26 revenue, with FY27 growth guided at 15-20%. Management expects export share to rise to 30-35% over time.

segments.name: Formulations
segments.commentary: Revenue INR23.3 crore in Q1. Cenobamate CDMO launch expected to add INR10-12 crore in FY27; Oncocare brand business covers 15+ brands across 23 states and 3 UTs.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth of 10-15% YoY; profit growth guided at a similar rate. FY28 top-line growth also guided at a similar rate.
EBITDA margin of 18-20% for FY27 and FY28.
Capex of INR40-50 crore every year over the next few years.
Medium term: management said INR900-1,000 crore revenue achievable in the next two to three years.
Revenue mix expected to normalise as exports improve and geopolitical conditions ease over the year.
Receivable days expected to settle at 110-120 days going forward.
capex_capacity: Peptide plant: installed capacity about 250 kg per annum, commissioning targeted for Q4 2027. Management said peak revenue at full utilisation could be INR200-300 crore at 18-20% EBITDA margin, ramping over two to three years.
Oncology API dedicated facility: commercial target Q4 2028.
Gen Rx Pharmaceutical facility in Nashik (solid dosage forms): acquisition pending NCLT approval; commercial production expected in H2 2027.
Savli DSIR-approved R&D centre expansion of over 10,000 sq ft, expected to be operational by August 2026, housing 100+ researchers. R&D spend rose from 0.4% of sales in 2024 to 2.2% in 2026.
Three loss-making Tarapur plants: one sold, two remain with no buyer yet; sale proceeds not quantified.
demand_pricing: API prices stable QoQ in Q1; management said future pricing depends on geopolitical developments and oil prices.
Semaglutide (first peptide planned) market price cited at USD120-150 per gram. Plant is designed for global markets, with initial work for India.
CDMO: DMFs filed in UK and EU and six CEP approvals received in the last 6-8 months. Management said first customer revenue could come at end-FY28, with quantum not yet estimated.
Cenobamate: SEC recommendation received; DCGI NOC and state licence still pending; tie-ups with eight Indian marketing companies, with the company acting as CDMO partner.
Suvorexant: BE studies completed; commercialisation expected Q4 FY28 because the patent is still in force.

Vitamin C is about 8-9% of revenue; backward integration via ICT MoU expected to complete in 2029. Eight to ten API molecules being backward-integrated, expected to be 20-25% of revenue, with a 1-2% margin uplift.

qa_highlights.question: Was domestic API growth driven by volume or price?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said API prices were stable QoQ, implying the growth was volume-led; it added that the outlook depends on geopolitics and oil prices.

qa_highlights.question: What revenue and profit growth is guided for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue growth of 10-15% for FY27, with profit growth expected at a similar rate.

qa_highlights.question: What is the commercial timeline for the peptide plant and the expected revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Plant commissioning Q4 2027 with Semaglutide as the first product. Peak revenue of INR200-300 crore at full utilisation, with 18-20% EBITDA margin. Management said commercial revenue would begin in 2028.

qa_highlights.question: What is the receivable days trend and target?
qa_highlights.answer: Receivable days fell to 131 from 145 at FY26 end; management expects 110-120 days going forward.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capex plan and acquisition outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Capex of INR40-50 crore each year. No further acquisitions planned until Gen Rx is commercialised.

qa_highlights.question: What working capital and inventory drivers apply?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said inventory rose in Q4 FY26 on war-related precautionary buying; the longer-term increase reflects a shift from a few high-volume products pre-COVID to a larger product basket.

risks_watch: Commercial launch timelines for peptide (Q4 2027), oncology API (Q4 2028), Gen Rx (H2 2027) and CDMO (end-FY28) all depend on approvals or commissioning and have not been demonstrated yet.
Cenobamate revenue of INR10-12 crore in FY27 depends on pending DCGI NOC and state licence.
Receivables are high at 131 days; the 110-120 day target depends on customer behaviour, including government and institutional clients.
Inventory has risen sharply versus FY21 on a broader product mix.
Two Tarapur loss-making plants remain unsold.
Opioid-derivative intermediates are still in R&D, and the Government of India discussion on capacity is unresolved.
Management declined to name most peptide molecules, citing confidentiality.
summary.management_tone: Confident on pipeline milestones and guidance, but vague on several quantifications (CDMO revenue quantum, Tarapur sale proceeds, peptide volume split). Several answers were brief or deferred offline, such as Suvorexant market size.
